proposal.rationale: Tennessee's Title 63 governs the healing arts and related professions. Section 63-1-102 enumerates practice-act chapters via "licensed under chapter X of this title" - a clear trigger introducing chapter citations within Title 63. Chapter cites are written as bare "chapter N" and section cites follow the 63-N-NNN pattern where the middle segment is the chapter token. The anchor text here is a definitions section ("For the purposes of this chapter") which is auto-detected by the cross-state AS_USED_RE, so we do not add it as a universal pattern. No strong universal phrases like "every person" or "any holder" appear in this anchor, so we keep universal patterns conservative and rely on trigger-based enumeration to map the listed practice-act chapters.
